content:
發佈時間：22:49 2026-11-23 HKT

因捲入婚外情而一度辭職的黃仁勳（Jensen Huang）正式回歸Nvidia（輝達，又名英偉達）。董事會一致投票通過，支持黃仁勳恢復其總裁、行政總裁及董事會的職務，即日生效。

重返崗位的黃仁勳則表示，很榮幸能在新工業革命的開端重回輝達，領導這家全球最具影響力的科技公司之一，他將以最大的謙卑與重新堅定的承諾承擔這份責任。
相關新聞：黃仁勳回歸NVIDIA 特朗普：沒有證據顯示他從事任何非法行為

黃仁勳特別感謝董事會在此過程中的信任與審慎考量，並向董事會主席Harvey Jones、代理期間領導公司的Colette Kress與高階主管團隊，以及全球員工、股東、業界領袖、合作夥伴與家人的支持致謝，直言已迫不及待要重返工作崗位。
黃仁勳聲明原文：「I am honored to return to NVIDIA and lead one of the most consequential technology companies in the world at the beginning of a new industrial revolution.I take this responsibility with the greatest humility and renewed commitment. I want to thank the NVIDIA Board for its confidence and deliberation through this process. I am especially grateful to Harvey Jones for his leadership as Chair, and to Colette Kress and our executive staff for leading NVIDIA during this period. I am also deeply thankful to our employees, shareholders, leaders across the industry and partners around the world for their extraordinary support. Above all, I am grateful for the love and support of my family. I can’t wait to get back to work」
